summary: Describes how to proxy UDP through HTTP, much as the HTTP CONNECT method proxies TCP. It defines a protocol letting an HTTP client create a tunnel for UDP traffic through an HTTP server acting as a proxy. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: A helper at the front desk can pass your regular letters on. Now they can also pass along quick postcards, sending UDP messages for you through the web connection.

questions: how to proxy udp over http
